title: Sacha Baron Cohen Says Donald Trump Has ‘Elements of Brilliance’ and ‘We Were Too Easy to Dismiss Him as a Nincompoop’
content:
ByAntonio Ferme

20 years after retiring Ali G,Sacha Baron Cohenhas dusted off his tracksuit collection and reprised the character for “Ali G: Who Iz I?,” now open in theaters before coming to Amazon Prime Oct. 30. The comedian first brought Ali G to audiences at the turn of the century with “Da Ali G Show,” where he interviewed some of the world’s most powerful figures (and, more often than not, made fools of them in the process).

“As Ali G, I had the privilege of sitting with some of the smartest and most powerful people in the world, and all of them were punctual,” Baron Cohen told Josh Horowitz Wednesday night during a live taping of “Happy Sad Confused” at New York’s 92nd Street Y. After a lengthy pause, he turned his attention to the one exception: “Donald Trumpkept us waiting for about 40 minutes.”

Baron Cohen recalled feeling “intimidated” upon entering Trump Tower with director James Bobin, where they waited in a room while Trump shouted a string of expletives “not for the likes of delicate Jewish ears” at Rudy Giuliani over the phone.

“Later on, I heard that he used to do that with other people,” Baron Cohen said. “It really was a power move.”

Trump appeared taken with Bobin, who Baron Cohen described as a “very handsome, blond, Oxford-educated” Englishman. But when he realized he’d be sitting down with Ali G instead, his demeanor “immediately” changed.

“I actually met a woman who was in the car with him after that interview, and he was apparently furious,” Baron Cohen said. “He actually went out publicly a couple of times to criticize me. And in the end, we used all those clips and used them to advertise another show that I did.”

Baron Cohen’s interview with Trump aired in 2003, back when the future president was best known as a New York real estate mogul, before going on to host NBC’s “The Apprentice.” Looking back at their encounter, Baron Cohen said he could understand how Trump won a second term in the White House, pointing to the president’s “elements of brilliance.”

“I mean, how has he survived a second term? People underestimated him,” Baron Cohen said. “We were too easy to dismiss him as a nincompoop. There are elements of brilliance to him, otherwise. And that explains his appeal with the fact that he’s there for a second term, the fact that he’s transforming this country. I won’t say positively or negatively.”

This was not the only time Baron Cohen reflected on Trump’s one-of-a-kind characteristics on his latest press tour. He told Kara Swisher and Scott Galloway onthe Pivot podcastthat the president is “amusing” and that there’s “a huge amount of comedy in the way he speaks.”

“He’s intentionally being funny,” Baron Cohen explained. “And if you have a look on the far right, they use comedy and sarcasm as an engaging way to dismiss criticisms.”

Baron Cohen suggests that Trump’s popularity, perhaps, reflects a broader theme explored through his own collection of provocative characters: “In the black and white, the world is a little bit complicated.”
title_zh: 薩查·巴倫·科恩(Sacha Baron Cohen)表示唐納德·特朗普(Donald Trump)擁有「卓越的元素」，並且「我們對他輕易地將其視為傻瓜」。
content_zh:
由安東尼·費爾梅(Antonio Ferme)報導

在退休20年後，薩查·巴倫·科恩(Sacha Baron Cohen)重新拾起他的運動服系列，並再次扮演角色阿里·G(Ali G)，推出了電影《阿里·G：我是誰？(Ali G: Who Iz I?)》，目前已在影院上映，並將於10月30日登陸亞馬遜Prime。這位喜劇演員在世紀之交首次將阿里·G帶給觀眾，透過《達·阿里·G秀(Da Ali G Show)》訪問了一些世界上最有權勢的人物（而且，往往在此過程中讓他們自取其辱）。

巴倫·科恩在紐約第92街Y的《快樂悲傷困惑(Happy Sad Confused)》現場錄影中告訴喬希·霍洛維茨(Josh Horowitz)：“作為阿里·G，我有幸與一些世界上最聰明和最有權力的人坐在一起，而他們都是準時的。”在經過一段長時間的停頓後，他將注意力轉向唯一的例外：“唐納德·特朗普(Donald Trump)讓我們等了大約40分鐘。”

巴倫·科恩回憶起與導演詹姆斯·博賓(James Bobin)一起進入特朗普大廈時感到“威脅”，他們在一個房間裡等候，而特朗普則在電話中對魯迪·朱利安尼(Rudy Giuliani)大聲咒罵，這些話“並不適合敏感的猶太耳朵”。

“後來，我聽說他以前也這樣對待其他人，”巴倫·科恩說。“這確實是一種權力的表現。”

特朗普似乎對博賓很感興趣，巴倫·科恩形容他是一位“非常英俊、金髮、牛津大學教育”的英國人。但當他意識到自己將與阿里·G坐下時，他的態度“立刻”改變。

“我實際上遇到了一位在那次訪談後與他同車的女性，顯然他非常生氣，”巴倫·科恩說。“他實際上公開批評過我幾次。最後，我們將所有那些片段用來宣傳我做的另一個節目。”

巴倫·科恩與特朗普的訪談於2003年播出，當時這位未來的總統最為人知的是紐約的房地產大亨，之後他主持了NBC的《學徒(The Apprentice)》。回顧他們的會面，巴倫·科恩表示他能理解特朗普如何贏得第二個白宮任期，並指出總統的“卓越之處”。

“我的意思是，他是如何在第二個任期中生存下來的？人們低估了他，”巴倫·科恩說。“我們太容易將他視為一個無能的人。其實他身上有一些卓越的特質。這也解釋了他能夠獲得第二個任期的吸引力，以及他正在改變這個國家的事實。我不會說是正面還是負面。”

這並不是巴倫·科恩在最新的宣傳巡迴中唯一一次反思特朗普獨特特徵的時刻。他在《Pivot》播客中告訴卡拉·斯維舍(Kara Swisher)和斯科特·加洛韋(Scott Galloway)，這位總統“有趣”，而且他的說話方式中“充滿了喜劇”。

“他故意在搞笑，”巴倫·科恩解釋道。“如果你看看極右派，他們用喜劇和諷刺作為一種引人入勝的方式來駁斥批評。”

巴倫·科恩(Baron Cohen)建議，特朗普的受歡迎程度或許反映了一個更廣泛的主題，這個主題在他自己的一系列挑釁性角色中得到了探討：“在黑與白之間，世界有些複雜。”
